methods.name: Quest skip to level 24
methods.note: Biohazard, Hazeel Cult, Fight Arena and Tower of Life give 5,425 XP, enough for the 21 that Tribal Totem needs; all five reach level 24.

methods.name: Chambers of Xeric thieving room
methods.note: Reload the raid until the first room is the thieving room, then pick the chests and drop the grubs; putting grubs in the trough ends the room.

methods.name: Ardougne bakery stalls
methods.note: In the East Ardougne market, stand under the baker so the guards cannot catch you. Ironmen bank the cakes and bread for early quests.

methods.name: Port Roberts stalls
methods.note: Steal 4 times from your best stall, then 2 from the next, in step with the guards; the stalls never run out. Gems, ores and cannonballs at higher levels.

methods.name: Hosidius fruit stalls
methods.note: Run between the two stalls in the house east of the market, where no dogs patrol; strange fruit restores run energy. Ironmen bank golovanova tops.

methods.name: Aldarin villa chests
methods.note: Six chests upstairs in the north-west villas of Aldarin; a failed pick can teleport you outside. Bring a lockpick and energy or stamina potions.

methods.name: Blackjacking Pollnivneach bandits
methods.note: The Feud only has to reach the blackjack part, and Menaphite Thugs take over at 65. Rates use jugs of wine from the bar; brews are a little faster.

methods.name: Stealing artefacts
methods.note: Port Piscarilius, with a lockpick. Rates assume staminas, lured guards and the Fisher's Flute teleport from The Queen of Thieves; 13% slower without it.

methods.name: Stealing valuables in Varlamore
methods.note: Pickpocket distracted wealthy citizens for house keys, then loot the empty house in long AFK stretches. Rates count the half hour of keys each hour of looting needs.

methods.name: Knights of Ardougne
methods.note: Pickpocket a trapped or splashed knight without moving the mouse. Rates assume dodgy necklaces; no fails from 95 with the medium Ardougne Diary.

methods.name: Sorceress's summer garden
methods.note: Sneak past the elementals for a summer sq'irk, about 36 seconds a lap, and trade the juice to Osman. Beer glasses are free on the shelves.

methods.name: Pyramid Plunder
methods.note: Starting Icthlarin's Little Helper opens Sophanem. Rates assume solo runs with a pharaoh's sceptre teleport; bring food, antipoison and staminas.

methods.name: Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests
methods.note: Open both rich chests in one house with a lockpick, then hop worlds; the loot comes back after 5 minutes. About 300,000 coins an hour when banking.

methods.name: Pickpocketing vyres
methods.note: Darkmeyer, with dodgy necklaces and the hard Ardougne Diary; Shadow Veil adds a little. Heavy on food or prayer, and a source of blood shards.

methods.name: Rogues' Castle chests
methods.note: Level 50 Wilderness, multi-combat: search for traps and pray melee. The loot needs the medium Wilderness Diary since January 2026; the XP does not.

methods.name: Master Farmers
methods.note: No fails at 94 with the hard Ardougne Diary. Ranarr and snapdragon seeds, more of them up to 85 Farming, and rogue equipment doubles them.

unverified: Quest skip to level 24: Biohazard 1,250, Hazeel Cult 1,500, Fight Arena 2,175, Tower of Life 500 and Tribal Totem 1,775 give 7,200 XP, level 24 at 7,028 (Quest experience rewards); Tribal Totem needs 21, which the other four reach (5,425); the guide's nine more quests add 41,500, level 42; no hourly rate (xph 0)

Chambers of Xeric thieving room: XP a chest is on no wiki page, so there is no model; 34,000 is 85% of the middle of the guide's 'up to 30,000-50,000' (an IP editor, November 2025); 'about one hour of raid time to level from 1-40' (a temporary account, July 2026) is 37,224 an hour; both rest on anonymous edits
Ardougne bakery stalls: 16 XP a steal every 5 ticks is the guide's 'up to 19,200'; 16,320 is 85%

Port Roberts stalls: bands are 85% of Port Roberts' own table of maxima (a steal every 5 ticks, 4 from the best stall and 2 from the next a 30-tick cycle), which the stall pages' XP rebuilds; the Thieving training guide's 20-34 row (6,015) is an error, the cycle gives 21,200; the page's 'around 97,000' at 65 when selling and hopping is 81% of its maximum; 50 Sailing to moor or charter there
Hosidius fruit stalls: 28.5 XP a steal every 4 ticks between two stalls is the guide's 'up to 42,750'; 36,300 is 85%; the ironman guide's 'about 37k' agrees within 2%

Aldarin villa chests: the guide (tested July 2026) says up to 60,000 'but 40,000-50,000 is more likely' with a lockpick; 45,000 is the lower of 85% of 60,000 and the middle of that range; the chest page's success and teleport charts with a 20 to 25 second walk back give 41,500 to 47,900 at 36 and 46,800 to 53,800 at 40, and its 'about 400 chests at 60' fits 25 seconds; the walk back is not measured anywhere

Blackjacking: bands are the lower of the guide's wine column and 85% of the wiki's maximum (a knock-out and two pickpockets every 6 ticks, 10 + 2 x the target's XP; knock-out 80/240): the wine column to 70, 85% of the maximum from 75 (222,400 to 237,300, against the column's 226,000 to 261,000); the guide's 86,000 at 45 is above Wise Old Man's 80,000 for 45 to 48, so that band is 80,000; a talk note of 2025 called the 45 rates an exaggeration; The Feud only needs to reach the blackjack part

Stealing artefacts: the page's table is arithmetic (750 + 40 x level, 48 an hour or 55 with the Fisher's Flute teleport); the guide's 'up to 270,000-280,000' at 99 is 58.4 an hour and Wise Old Man's rows 51 to 59; bands are 85% of 58.4, 49.6 an hour; they assume the teleport from The Queen of Thieves (not in req) and about 30 stamina doses an hour; without the teleport the page gives 48 an hour, 13% slower

Stealing valuables: the page's 72,000 to 105,000 is burgling alone and assumes few flashing arrows are missed; the bands add the guide's 30 minutes of key pickpocketing at about 65,000 an hour for each hour of burgling (20 keys); the Wealthy citizen page's timings give 63,000 and 38.6 keys an hour, which agrees; the rogue outfit halves the key time (about 6% more at 99)

Knights of Ardougne: bands are 85% of the wiki's maximum with the medium diary (55/264) and dodgy necklaces, from 80,300 at 55 to 215,000 from 95 (the tick-perfect 252,900); the guide's table is 91 to 95% of that maximum; the Ultimate Ironman guide's figures (about 60,000 at 55, 150,000 at 80) look like rates without the diary; the diary is now in req

Sorceress's summer garden: 3,000 XP a juice, two sq'irks a juice, one sq'irk a 36-second lap: 150,000 at most, 'realistically around 140,000' (Sorceress's Garden/Summer); 127,500 is 85% of the maximum; the lap time is the page's one-click route

Pyramid Plunder: 85% of the guide's and the minigame page's maxima (122,500 at 71, 190,000 at 81, 272,500 at 91, solo with a pharaoh's sceptre); an ironman without a sceptre walks in through the right door, which no page rates; Icthlarin's Little Helper only needs to be started, or a main can buy a sceptre (8,750,407 coins on 16 October 2026)
Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests: 187,000 is 85% of the guide's 'up to 210,000-230,000' (340 chests an hour across 170 worlds), under its 'around 190,000' when banking; busy worlds lower it

Pickpocketing vyres: the guide's 120,000 at 82 to 180,000 at 99 is 74 to 83% of the wiki's maximum with dodgy necklaces and the hard diary, so it stands; the bands between are its straight line every four levels; the ironman guide gives 140,000 to about 190,000 with Shadow Veil; food or prayer for about 2,000 hitpoints of damage an hour; before The Blood Moon Rises the vyre noble clothing must be worn, so only the rogue mask and gloves fit

Rogues' Castle chests: 255,000 is 85% of 'at least 300,000' uninterrupted (both the guide and the chest page), under the guide's 260,000-270,000 when banking; three chests on a 34-tick reset allow up to 529 opens an hour, so the chest is not the limit; player killers lower it; loot needs the medium Wilderness Diary since 28 January 2026; 43 Prayer for Protect from Melee is now in req

Master Farmers: 99,900 is 85% of the guide's 'up to 115,000-120,000'; 3,000 pickpockets at 43 XP is 129,000 at most; since 30 July 2025 the Civitas farmers no longer stand still after being spoken to, which the guide's advice still assumes, so trap one instead

Efficiency ceilings (Wise Old Man, 16 October 2026): 15,000 main and 26,000 ironman for 1 to 45 (quests and fruit stalls together, not a rate for any one method), 80,000 blackjacking for 45 to 48, then stealing artefacts with firemaking or glassblowing from 49, whose Thieving share (160,500 to 260,000 main, 152,000 to 245,000 ironman) is the ceiling for artefacts; single-skill methods such as blackjacking, Pyramid Plunder and the Rogues' Castle can pass that share, as the table's own note says Pyramid Plunder does once no other skill is left; TempleOSRS has the same rows

Not included: men and women and the East Ardougne door (1 to 5; the quest skip and the raid cover them); tea and silk stalls (slower respawns); elves (85, at most 138,000 with the hard diary at 85, Song of the Elves); TzHaar-Hur (needs the Thieving cape, past 99); underwater thieving (0.099 x level squared a tear, 107,000 to 157,000 at 85, made for Agility and Thieving together); Molch stone chests (90,000 to 110,000 at 78); Varlamore gem stalls (150,000 to 170,000 at 75 by world hopping); pirates (72 XP); Sailing's pirate chests and the Isle of Souls chest (no rate anywhere); wall safes; Hallowed Sepulchre coffins (Agility)
